sentences.japanese: 一束だけ一番上に本物の札がのっていた。
sentences.english: Only one stack had a real bill on top.

sentences.japanese: たくさん札束が入っていたが、１０００ドル札ではなかった。
sentences.english: There were lots of bundles, but they weren't thousand-dollar bills.
It was a one hundred dollar bill.

sentences.japanese: そうしたら、茂みの下にいくつかの１０００ドル札の束を見つけ、それをバスケットの中に入れた。
sentences.english: Then she found several stacks of thousand-dollar bills under a bush and put them in her basket.

sentences.japanese: このお札を両替してくださいませんか。
sentences.english: Could you change this bill, please?
